subject: Post-demo: Rapid proof-of-value (3-week) proposal & success gates
summary: Post-demo recap and proposed 3-week rapid proof-of-value with clear success gates, owners, and kickoff next steps.
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@pioneerstack.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@pioneerstack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Rapid proof-of-value (3-week) proposal & success gates

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Great discussion — I captured the key asks and a compact proposal below so your team can review and give a quick yes/no on the scope. The idea is a focused 3-week rapid proof-of-value (PoV) to validate latency and retrieval quality for your triage workflows, with two gating checks so we can stop early if we need to re-scope.

Proposed scope (3 weeks)
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): data extract + secure upload, access config (VPC peering or S3 transfer), Redwood onboarding, baseline metrics.
- Week 1 (ingest & baseline): vectorize sample dataset (50k docs), baseline retrieval/intent model performance, initial latency profiling.
- Week 2 (tuning & eval): apply Redwood batching and KV cache, run two model variants (opt1: quantized LLM for retrieval; opt2: hybrid reranker), measure accuracy/latency and operational costs.

Success gates (must meet both to be "pass")
1) Quality: triage intent F1 >= 0.80 on the labeled 2k holdout set OR retrieval MRR uplift >= 20% vs current system.
2) Performance: median token latency (end-to-end for inference) <= 350ms and 99th percentile <= 1.2s for 95% of production-like requests.

Ownership / roles
- PioneerStack: provide 1) sample labeled holdout (2k rows) + 50k anonymized docs, 2) credentials for S3 or a secure transfer method (owner: Priya).
- Redwood: pilot infra, model variants, runbook for performance tuning, weekly status (owner: Stephanie).
- Solutions / Eng support: Karthik to handle integration and on-call triage during ingest.
- CS / Success: Marissa to lead acceptance and post-PoV handoff.

Deliverables
- Week-by-week runbook and test plan (attached PDF).
- Data extract spec (CSV stub attached).
- Pilot SLA and operational runbook (docx attached).

Next steps (proposed)
1) Confirm scope and data transfer method by EOD Friday (23 Oct).
2) Kickoff call to schedule Week 0 activities w/ eng leads (propose Tue 27 Oct).
3) Legal/procurement touchpoint for data & SLA (we can send a short statement of work and pilot addendum).

If you want to tighten or loosen the scope (e.g., 2-week micro-pilot or expanded 5-week validation), we can adjust — this is the minimal plan to show measurable signal.

Thanks — I attached the one-page runbook and the data spec for your team to circulate.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: rw-pv-proposal-pioneerstack.pdf (1 page), pioneerstack-data-extract-spec.csv (stub), redwood-pilot-sla.docx (pilot SLA)

Stephanie — thanks for the clear recap. This looks close to what we discussed. A couple quick items from our side: 
- Can we tighten the data transfer statement for PII? Our security team will need to confirm the exact fields; Priya, can you share the redaction checklist?
- On quality gates: the product team prefers F1 >= 0.82 for intent classification rather than 0.80; is that achievable within the tuning window?

Assuming yes on the redaction checklist and the F1 target, we can confirm by Friday. Also looping in Procurement next (I'll forward your SLA doc to them).

—Alex
